nodes.description: Public total token supply declared in ERC20Basic; set to INITIAL_SUPPLY in the EtherLinkToken constructor.
Mapping(address => uint256) of token balances in BasicToken; the primary value store mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of allowances in StandardToken; mutated by approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
Public token name string set to 'EtherLink Token'.
Public token symbol string set to 'ETL'.
Public decimals value 18 used in computing INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Constant initial supply 5000000 * 10**decimals assigned to totalSupply and to the deployer balance.
BasicToken.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): decrements msg.sender balance via SafeMath.sub and increments _to balance via SafeMath.add, then emits Transfer.
BasicToken.balanceOf(address _owner) constant: returns balances[_owner].
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): reads allowed[_from][msg.sender], moves balances and decrements the allowance via SafeMath.sub.
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval; vulnerable to the classic approval race condition.
StandardToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender) constant: returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue): adds to allowed[msg.sender][_spender] using SafeMath.add.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue): conditionally zeroes or subtracts from allowed[msg.sender][_spender] using SafeMath.sub.
Constructor of EtherLinkToken: sets totalSupply to INITIAL_SUPPLY and assigns the entire supply to msg.sender.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b): computes c = a * b and asserts a == 0 || c / a == b to guard multiplication overflow.
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b): returns a / b; Solidity throws on division by zero.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): asserts b <= a then returns a - b, guarding subtraction underflow.
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b): computes c = a + b and asserts c >= a to guard addition overflow.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as the balance/allowance owner key and as the recipient of the initial supply.
Arithmetic overflow surface guarded by SafeMath.add (assert c >= a) and SafeMath.mul (assert a == 0 || c / a == b) on uint256 balances and allowances.
Arithmetic underflow surface guarded by SafeMath.sub (assert b <= a) when decrementing balances, the allowance, or applying _subtractedValue.
Parameter _to (address) in transfer and transferFrom: destination address, must not be address(0).
Parameter _value (uint256) in transfer, transferFrom and approve: token amount being moved or authorized.
Parameter _owner (address) in balanceOf and allowance: address whose balance or allowance is queried.
Parameter _from (address) in transferFrom: source address whose balance and allowance are debited.
Parameter _spender (address) in approve, allowance, increaseApproval and decreaseApproval: address being granted or checked an allowance.
Parameter _addedValue (uint) in increaseApproval: delta added to the caller's allowance for _spender.
Parameter _subtractedValue (uint) in decreaseApproval: delta removed from the caller's allowance for _spender.
Local uint oldValue in decreaseApproval: snapshot of allowed[msg.sender][_spender] used for the comparison branch.
Local uint256 _allowance in transferFrom: cached value of allowed[_from][msg.sender] before debiting.
Local uint256 c in SafeMath.mul and SafeMath.add holding the unchecked product/sum result.
Parameter a (uint256) in SafeMath.mul, div, sub and add: the left operand.
Parameter b (uint256) in SafeMath.mul, div, sub and add: the right operand / divisor / subtrahend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the account whose balance is debited in transfer, so the caller controls which balance is reduced.
_to is the destination whose balance is credited in transfer.
_value flows into the sub/add balance updates in transfer.
require(_to != address(0)) gates execution of transfer before any state write.
transfer writes the balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
The add check result from SafeMath.add guards the balance credit inside transfer.
The sub underflow check from SafeMath.sub guards the sender balance debit inside transfer.
SafeMath.add produces the overflow-checked sum represented by the arithmetic safety operation.
SafeMath.mul produces the overflow-checked product represented by the arithmetic safety operation.
SafeMath.sub produces the underflow-checked difference represented by the arithmetic safety operation.
Local c holds the unchecked a*b / a+b result that the assertions must constrain.
Operand a flows into mul.
Operand b flows into mul.
Operand a flows into add.
Operand b flows into add.
Operand a flows into sub.
Operand b flows into sub and is compared with a in the assertion.
Operand a flows into div as the dividend.
Operand b flows into div as the divisor.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried owner.
_owner is the lookup key used to read balances in balanceOf.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
_owner is the outer key of allowed in allowance.
_spender is the inner key of allowed in allowance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender], so the caller controls the owner side of the allowance.
_spender is the spender key written by approve.
_value is the raw allowance amount written by approve without a reset-to-zero step.
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom, so the caller controls the debit path.
_from is the balance and allowance source key used by transferFrom.
_to is the destination credited by transferFrom.
_value flows into the sub/add balance updates and the allowance decrement.
require(_to != address(0)) gates execution of transferFrom.
_allowance caches allowed[_from][msg.sender] and drives the allowance decrement.
transferFrom mutates the balances of _from and _to.
transferFrom decreases allowed[_from][msg.sender].
SafeMath.sub is applied to the cached _allowance, an underflow-checked subtraction.
increaseApproval modifies allowed[msg.sender][_spender], caller-controlled allowance.
_spender identifies the allowance slot incremented.
_addedValue is the increment applied to the allowance.
increaseApproval relies on SafeMath.add, an overflow-guarded addition of the allowance.
decreaseApproval modifies allowed[msg.sender][_spender], caller-controlled allowance.
_spender identifies the allowance slot decremented.
_subtractedValue is compared against oldValue and subtracted from the allowance.
oldValue supplies the branch condition and the subtraction base.
decreaseApproval performs an underflow-checked subtraction via SafeMath.sub.
The if (_subtractedValue > oldValue) branch selects either a hard zero write or the sub path.
INITIAL_SUPPLY is assigned to totalSupply inside the constructor.
decimals is used to compute INITIAL_SUPPLY (5000000 * 10**uint256(decimals)).
The constructor grants the entire initial supply to msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged holder.
Constructor writes totalSupply.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender].

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only exists to serve transfer/transferFrom destination logic; fold it into the transfer function node.
Parameter _value is the amount consumed by transfer's sub/add balance updates; fold it into transfer.
Parameter _owner is only a lookup key for allowance/balanceOf; fold it into the allowance function node.
Parameter _from is a source key used exclusively by transferFrom; fold it into transferFrom.
Parameter _spender is the allowance target key set by approve; fold it into approve.
Parameter _addedValue is the increment input of increaseApproval; fold it into increaseApproval.
Parameter _subtractedValue is the decrement input of decreaseApproval; fold it into decreaseApproval.
Local oldValue is a temporary snapshot inside decreaseApproval; fold it into decreaseApproval.
Local _allowance is a temporary cache read inside transferFrom; fold it into transferFrom.
Local c holds the unchecked arithmetic result in mul/add; fold it into the arithmetic unsafe_operation node.
Generic operand a belongs to the SafeMath arithmetic checks; fold it into the arithmetic unsafe_operation node.
Generic operand b belongs to the SafeMath arithmetic checks; fold it into the arithmetic unsafe_operation node.
